source_text.ISS-0347: ISSUE-FIXER's diagnosis (handoffs/WF03-ISS0347-20260826/step-01-issue-fixer.json result): root cause is lint_file/2's parse-error branch (lib/mix/tasks/letflow.lint_handoffs.ex:398) setting advisory: [] while every other branch produces %{path:, warnings:, size_info:}. print_advisory/1 (line ~697) does unchecked r.advisory.warnings dot-access, crashing with BadMapError on the shape-drifted []. ORCH has already fixed today's specific instances (BOM strip, H1/H3 data corrections) directly on main -- this design's job is to make the CODE robust so a future malformed/parse-error handoff file degrades gracefully (an advisory-list entry or a skipped/reported line) instead of crashing the whole lint_handoffs task.

task.description: CODE-DESIGNER (WF-03 Step 2, fix design). Design a fix for lib/mix/tasks/letflow.lint_handoffs.ex so a parse-error/malformed handoff file (advisory: []) can never crash print_advisory/1's unchecked map dot-access. Design-only -- no implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: Design shows how lint_file/2's parse-error branch's advisory shape either matches the map shape print_advisory/1 expects (path/warnings/size_info), or how print_advisory/1 is changed to safely handle a non-map/empty advisory value without raising
Design does not merely special-case today's BOM trigger -- it must generalize to any future parse-error-producing malformed handoff (any Jason.DecodeError cause, not just BOM)
Design states the function signature/type shape change precisely (no implementation code, signatures/type shapes only)
Design confirms no other caller of the parse-error branch's return value breaks under the corrected shape
No new public function/module needed if avoidable -- prefer the smallest correct fix; if a helper is genuinely needed, name its signature

result.summary: Chose approach (a): normalize lint_file/2's {:error, reason} parse-error branch (line 398) to set advisory: %{path: path, warnings: [], size_info: %{desc_len: 0, summary_len: 0}} -- the same advisory_map() shape already produced by the :non_json branch (line 360) and check_advisory/2 (line 541-589) -- instead of advisory: []. Rejected approach (b) (defensive shape-check in print_advisory/1) because the map shape is lint_file/2's existing return contract, not incidental input variance; patching the consumer would hide the producer bug and leave an undocumented union return type. The fix is keyed on the branch, not on `reason`'s value, so it generalizes to any Jason.DecodeError/File.read failure cause, not just today's BOM. Traced all consumers of lint_file/2's five result keys: advisory is read only by print_advisory/1 (lines 697, 708, 722, all via r.advisory.warnings/size_info) which now receives a uniform advisory_map() from every branch; hard_new/hard_grandfathered (consumed at line 246 and 673-674) and parse_error are untouched by this change. No new public function needed -- the fix reuses the exact literal already used at line 360.
